# Introduction

This notebook analyzes metatranscriptomic (RNA-seq) data from an *Aiptasia* bacterial inoculation experiment. *Aiptasia* were first treated with antibiotics to reduce their native microbiome, then inoculated with one of three bacterial symbionts to examine changes in host, algal symbiont, and bacterial gene expression.

*Still needed*:
refine annotation categories at end of DEGs and look at unannoated ones for TrEMBL annotations

**Treatments:**

- **control/FASW** — no antibiotics, no inoculation (natural microbiome)
- **ABS** — antibiotics only (microbiome-depleted baseline)
- **ISOA/Labrenzia** — antibiotics + *Labrenzia aggregata* inoculation
- **ISOB/Ruegeria** — antibiotics + *Ruegeria mobilis* inoculation
- **ISOC/Vibrio** — antibiotics + *Vibrio alginolyticus* inoculation
- **ISOABC/multi** — antibiotics + all three bacteria combined

**Timepoints:** 1 day post-inoculation (1dpi) and 21 days post-inoculation (21dpi)

**Replicates:** 4 biological replicates per treatment per timepoint = **48 samples total**

**Previous pipeline:** Raw reads were processed with fastp (quality trimming) → SortMeRNA (rRNA removal) → HISAT2 (alignment to a combined reference genome containing *Aiptasia* host, *Symbiodiniaceae* symbiont, *Labrenzia*, *Ruegeria*, and *Vibrio*) → featureCounts (gene-level quantification).

**Biological questions:**

1. What are the general expression patterns across treatments and timepoints?
2. How does bacterial inoculation affect host immune gene expression?
3. Are there changes in sulfur cycling genes, particularly in *Labrenzia* and *Ruegeria*?

**Updated questions**
1. Is there a common host response to bacteria inoculation regardless of treatment?
- compare ABS to each treatment at each timepoint 

2. How does host expression change when inoculated with vibrio alone vs. in multi-species combinations? 
Hypotheses: 
- Host gene expression is more similar with inoculations of beneficial microbes vs pathogen
- Inoculation of multispecies together causes differences in host gene expression 
- Inoculation of pathogen results in DE expression of key genes involved in immune systems and the presence of other bacteria dampens that response (idea --> BMCs do not want to be targeted?)

3. Are there changes in host gene expression that work to recognizing BMCs and not pathogens?

# 3. DESeq2 Analysis — Host (*Aiptasia*)

Host differential expression analysis using DESeq2. DESeq2 models RNA-seq count data using a negative binomial distribution, accounts for library size differences between samples, and uses shrinkage to produce more reliable fold-change estimates.

The design should include three terms: timepoint, teratment and treatment:timepoint interaction

## 3.1 Create DESeq object, filter data and run LRT test

https://bioconductor.org/packages/devel/bioc/vignettes/DESeq2/inst/doc/DESeq2.html#countmat
As per recommendations in Interactions section: 

```{r specify models and generate DESeq Object}
dds_aip <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_aip,
  colData = colData,
  design = ~ timepoint*treatment)

cat(nrow(dds_aip), "genes before filtering\n")
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds_aip) >= 10) >= 4
dds_aip <- dds_aip[keep, ]
cat(nrow(dds_aip), "genes after filtering\n")
#removes genes that don't have at least 10 counts in at least 4 samples, this helps to reduced noise in analysis 
```

## 3.2 Run DESeq analysis 
want to look at differences in gene expression at each time-point across treatment groups
```{r}
ds<-DESeq(dds_aip)
plotDispEsts(ds)
# Dispersion plot looks good: trend line decreases smoothly, gene-wise estimates converge (black dots)
```

Impacts of the antibiotics is negligble at day 21

```{r PERMANOVA}
# get VST matrix (samples as rows)
vsd_mat <- t(assay(vsd_aip))

# pull metadata
meta <- as.data.frame(colData(vsd_aip))

# run PERMANOVA
perm_res_global <- adonis2(vsd_mat ~ treatment*timepoint,
                    data = meta,
                    method = "euclidean",
                    permutations = 999,
                    by=NULL)
perm_res_global
```

```{r}
perm_res <- adonis2(vsd_mat ~ treatment*timepoint,
                    data = meta,
                    method = "euclidean",
                    permutations = 999,
                    by="terms")
perm_res
```
Significant effect of time but not treatment on expression profiles
Suggests that expression differences are related to ABS exposure and not to microbial inoculations.

## 3.4 Contrasts
### 1dpi
```{r 1 dpi contrasts}
tp<-'1dpi'
dds_aip_1dpi <- ds[, ds$timepoint == tp]
dds_aip_1dpi$timepoint <- droplevels(dds_aip_1dpi$timepoint)
design(dds_aip_1dpi) <- ~ treatment
dds_aip_1dpi$treatment <- relevel(dds_aip_1dpi$treatment, ref = "ABS")
dds_aip_1dpi <- DESeq(dds_aip_1dpi)  # re-run after releveling

resultsNames(dds_aip_1dpi)

#contrasts
res_aip_1dpi_control <- results(dds_aip_1dpi, name = "treatment_FASW_vs_ABS")
res_aip_1dpi_ISOA <- results(dds_aip_1dpi, name = "treatment_Labrenzia_vs_ABS")
res_aip_1dpi_ISOB <- results(dds_aip_1dpi, name = "treatment_Ruegeria_vs_ABS")
res_aip_1dpi_ISOC <- results(dds_aip_1dpi, name = "treatment_Vibrio_vs_ABS")
res_aip_1dpi_ISOABC <- results(dds_aip_1dpi, name = "treatment_multi_vs_ABS")

#contrasts with lfcShring
res_aip_1dpi_control_shrunk <- lfcShrink(dds_aip_1dpi, coef = "treatment_FASW_vs_ABS", res = res_aip_1dpi_control,type = "apeglm")
res_aip_1dpi_ISOA_shrunk <- lfcShrink(dds_aip_1dpi, coef = "treatment_Labrenzia_vs_ABS", res = res_aip_1dpi_ISOA,type = "apeglm")
res_aip_1dpi_ISOB_shrunk <- lfcShrink(dds_aip_1dpi, coef = "treatment_Ruegeria_vs_ABS", res = res_aip_1dpi_ISOB,type = "apeglm")
res_aip_1dpi_ISOC_shrunk <- lfcShrink(dds_aip_1dpi, coef = "treatment_Vibrio_vs_ABS", res = res_aip_1dpi_ISOC,type = "apeglm")
res_aip_1dpi_ISOABC_shrunk <- lfcShrink(dds_aip_1dpi, coef = "treatment_multi_vs_ABS", res = res_aip_1dpi_ISOABC,type = "apeglm")
```

## 3.5 DEGs Tables with annotations

```{r}
# parse annotation table & prep for analysis
annot <- aip_annotate %>%
  mutate(
    # Short accession: UniProt ID for sp/tr, RefSeq ID for nr
    accession = case_when(
      str_detect(Hit.accession, "^(sp|tr)\\|") ~ str_split_i(Hit.accession, "\\|", 2),
      str_detect(Hit.accession, "^gi\\|")      ~ str_extract(Hit.accession, "(?<=ref\\|)[^|]+"),
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    # UniProt entry name, e.g. FBX4_BOVIN
    entry_name = if_else(str_detect(Hit.accession, "^(sp|tr)\\|"),
                         str_split_i(Hit.accession, "\\|", 3), NA_character_),
    # Gene symbol from description, e.g. FBXO4
    gene_name = str_extract(Hit.description, "(?<=GN=)\\S+"),
    # Best single label: gene name > entry name > accession
    geneid = coalesce(gene_name, entry_name, accession)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Protein_ID, gene_id, Source, geneid, accession, entry_name, gene_name,Hit.description, GO.terms)
annot
```



```{r}
#helpfunction to make DEG table
make_deg_table <- function(comp_data, comparison, timepoint, annotation_table,
                           padj_cutoff = 0.05) {
  as.data.frame(comp_data) %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "row_id") %>%
    mutate(Protein_ID = sub("_gene", "", row_id)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj), padj < padj_cutoff) %>%
    left_join(annotation_table, by = "Protein_ID") %>%
    mutate(comp = comparison, timepoint = timepoint) %>%
    dplyr::select(Protein_ID, geneid, comp, timepoint,
                  baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, padj,
                  Source, accession, entry_name, gene_name,
                  Hit.description, GO.terms) %>%
    arrange(padj)
}
```

###3.5.3 DEG tables for analyses
```{r combine deg tables}

#all DEGs
deg_names <- ls(pattern = "^deg_set")
deg_list <- mget(deg_names) #put dataframes into list 
deg_list <- deg_list[!sapply(deg_list, is.null)]# Drop any NULLs
deg_list <- deg_list[sapply(deg_list, nrow) > 0] # Drop any with 0 rows
combined_deg <- bind_rows(deg_list, .id = "source")
combined_deg

#DEGs of interest across treatments, not FASW vs. ABS
degs_of_interest<-combined_deg %>% 
                  filter(!comp=="FASW_vs_ABS")
dim(degs_of_interest)
length(unique(degs_of_interest$Protein_ID))


#degs in FASW vs. ABS
abs_fasw_degs <- combined_deg %>%
  filter(comp == "FASW_vs_ABS", padj < 0.05) %>%   #adjust padj cutoff if needed
  distinct(Protein_ID, timepoint)

#DEGs of interest, excluding all ABS and FASW DEGs
degs_of_interest.ex<-degs_of_interest %>%
  anti_join(abs_fasw_degs, by = c("Protein_ID", "timepoint"))
dim(degs_of_interest.ex)
```

```{r}
#set gene categories & assign
category_keywords<-list(
  "Adhesion" = c('Fat3','Nos7524_1372','CDCP2'),
  "Cell cycle" = c('RAB36','ssx2ip-a','TTC28'),
  "Sensory/neuronal" = c('SYT1','Chrna3','BB4'),
  "DNA repair" = c('DPOM_ASCIM','wrn'),
  "Immunity" = c('Fam26f','nlrc5','PRPX_HORVU', 'CPAMD8',"WP_011192704.1","OIT3"),
  "Ion channel" = c('SLC38A6'),
  "Oxylipin signaling" = c('trp-1','TRPC6'),
  "Metabolism" =c("CYP3A24","hyuA","ca2"),
  "Oxidative stress"=c("TP53I3","Hao1","CYBB"),
  "Sulfur metabolism"=c("mocos","TST"),
  "Lipid metabolism" =c("hsd17b12","PLA2G4A"),
  "Signaling" = c("SCOP1","Plch2","PRKX","Vwde"),
  "Transcription regulation" = c('Elk1','ZNF510','ANKRD12','KLF8','NKX1-1'),
  "Transport"=c('CUBN'),
  "Transposable element" = c('LIN1_NYCCO','POL','pol',"X-element"),
  "Growth regulation" = c("RERG","fgfr1a","Ptchd3","HMCN1"),
  "Signaling/defense" = c("Flt3","MIB1")
)

#1 turn list into look up table
keyword_df <- stack(category_keywords) %>%
  transmute(key = toupper(values),          # case-insensitive matching
            category = as.character(ind)) %>%
  distinct() 
keyword_df

# 2. Assign categories (exact match on gene_name, then entry_name, then geneid)
lookup <- function(x) keyword_df$category[match(toupper(x), keyword_df$key)]

deg <- degs_of_interest.ex %>%
  mutate(category = coalesce(lookup(gene_name),
                             lookup(entry_name),
                             lookup(geneid),
                             "Unassigned"))

# 3. Check the results
table(deg$category)

#things not matching
setdiff(keyword_df$key,
        toupper(c(deg$gene_name, deg$entry_name, deg$geneid)))
```

```{r summary table}
deg_summary<-combined_deg %>% group_by(comp, timepoint) %>% 
  summarize(nr_DEGs=length(Protein_ID), up=sum(log2FoldChange>1),down=sum(log2FoldChange<1))
deg_summary<-deg_summary %>% arrange(timepoint,comp)
deg_summary
write.csv(deg_summary,file.path(path.out,'summary_DEGs.csv'))
```


## 3.6 Visualization 

###3.6.1 Compare nr of DEGs across groups between base (ABS) and treatment conditions 
#### ABS vs. FASW
```{r}
#subset to only have FASW vs ABS
df_filtered_control<-combined_deg %>% filter(Protein_ID %in% abs_fasw_degs$Protein_ID) %>% filter(comp=="FASW_vs_ABS")
table(df_filtered_control$comp)

# set up data for plotting
df <- df_filtered_control %>% 
  separate(comp, into = c('treatment','base'), sep = "_vs_") %>% 
  mutate(direction = case_when(
    log2FoldChange > 1  ~ 'up',
    log2FoldChange < -1 ~ 'down',
    TRUE                ~ 'no change'
  ))


#plot
ggplot(df, aes(x = treatment, y = log2FoldChange, color = direction)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = 'dashed', color = 'gray60', linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'solid', color = 'gray85', linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0, width = 0.15, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.8) + 
  facet_grid(. ~ timepoint) + 
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Direction",
    values = c("up" = "#E63946",    # red
               "down" = "#457B9D",  # blue
               "NC" = "gray70"),
    labels = c("up" = "Up", "down" = "Down", "NC" = "No change")
  ) +
  labs(
    y = expression(log[2]~"(Fold Change)")
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) + ylim(c(-3,4))

ggsave(file.path(path.out,'deg_geneplot_control.svg'),height = 6, width=4)
```

### 3.6.2 Heatmaps of DEGs
- Plot DEGs from each treatment (Labrenzia, Reugeria, Vibrio and Mult) excluding those in ABS vs FASW for all comparisons 
- Filter genes with padj < 0.05
- We are not plotting DEGs bewteen ASW and FASW as these genes dominate expression differences in system 

#### 1 dpi
```{r}
timepoint_label<-'1dpi'
vsd<-vsd_aip

sig_genes<-deg %>% 
                    filter(timepoint==timepoint_label) %>% 
                    mutate(Protein_ID=paste0(Protein_ID,"_gene")) %>% 
                    pull(Protein_ID)

#get mat and transform to z-score
mat<-assay(vsd[, vsd$timepoint == timepoint_label])[sig_genes, ] 
mat_z<-t(scale(t(mat)))
mat<-mat[complete.cases(mat_z),]

title<-cat(timepoint_label, "union DEGs:", length(sig_genes), "->", nrow(mat_z), "plotted\n")

# Column annotation
ann_col <- data.frame(
    Treatment = vsd[, vsd$timepoint == timepoint_label]$treatment,
    row.names = colnames(mat_z))

#row annotations
row_lab <- deg$geneid[match(rownames(mat_z), paste0(deg$Protein_ID,"_gene"))]

p <- pheatmap(mat_z,
    annotation_col = ann_col,
    annotation_colors = list(
    Treatment = palette),
    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = F,
    labels_row = row_lab,
    fontsize_row = 5.5,
    #kmeans_k=3,
    cutree_rows = 3,
    cutree_cols = 4,
    main = paste0("DEGs, Aiptasia ", timepoint_label,
                  " (", nrow(mat_z), " genes), Z-score"),
    silent = TRUE)
grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(p$gtable)

```

###3.6.3 Heatmaps wiht annotated functions

#### 1 dpi

```{r}
timepoint_label <- "1dpi"
vsd <- vsd_aip

## ---- DEGs for this timepoint ----
deg.tp <- deg %>%
  dplyr::filter(timepoint == timepoint_label) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(row_id = paste0(Protein_ID, "_gene"))

sig_genes <- unique(deg.tp$row_id)

## ---- matrix + z-score ----
vsd_tp  <- vsd[, vsd$timepoint == timepoint_label]
mat     <- assay(vsd_tp)[rownames(vsd_tp) %in% sig_genes, ]
mat_z   <- t(scale(t(mat)))
mat_z   <- mat_z[complete.cases(mat_z), ]    # drop zero-variance rows

message(timepoint_label, ": ", length(sig_genes), " unique DEGs, ",
        sum(sig_genes %in% rownames(vsd_tp)), " found in vsd, ",
        nrow(mat_z), " plotted")

## ---- one row per gene for labels + categories ----
gene_info <- deg.tp %>%
  dplyr::distinct(row_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

row_lab <- gene_info$geneid[match(rownames(mat_z), gene_info$row_id)]
row_lab <- ifelse(is.na(row_lab) | row_lab == "",
                  sub("_gene$", "", rownames(mat_z)), row_lab)

row_categories <- gene_info$category[match(rownames(mat_z), gene_info$row_id)]
row_categories[is.na(row_categories) | row_categories == "Unknown"] <- "Unassigned"

## ---- annotations ----
cat_colors <- c(cat_base, "Unassigned" = "grey90")

ann_row <- data.frame(
  Category  = factor(row_categories,
                     levels = intersect(names(cat_colors), row_categories)),
  row.names = rownames(mat_z)
)

ann_col <- data.frame(
  Treatment = vsd_tp$treatment,
  row.names = colnames(mat_z)
)

## ---- heatmap ----
p_heat_1dpi <- pheatmap(mat_z,
  annotation_col    = ann_col,
  annotation_row    = ann_row,
  annotation_colors = list(
    Treatment = palette,
    Category  = cat_colors[levels(ann_row$Category)]   # name must match column
  ),
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  labels_row    = row_lab,
  fontsize_row  = 5.5,
  cutree_rows   = 3,
  cutree_cols   = 4,
  main = paste0("DEGs, Aiptasia ", timepoint_label,
                " (", nrow(mat_z), " genes), Z-score"),
  silent = TRUE)

grid::grid.newpage(); grid::grid.draw(p_heat_1dpi$gtable)

pdf(file.path(path.out, "annotated_heatmap_1dpi.pdf"), width = 8, height = 8)
grid::grid.draw(p_heat_1dpi$gtable)
dev.off()
```

###3.6.4 Gene expression rel to ABS

```{r get count data}
# Get count data

#get counts
ds_sf<- estimateSizeFactors(ds)
norm_counts <- counts(ds_sf, normalized = TRUE)

#subset genes that have abs(log2foldchange >1)
deg.lcfc2<-deg %>% filter(abs(log2FoldChange) > 1)
```

```{r}
#get all DEGs of interest regardless of L2FC and subset count data
deg_ids <- deg %>% pull(Protein_ID) %>% unique() #93 genes in total 
norm_sub <- norm_counts[rownames(norm_counts) %in% paste0(deg_ids,"_gene"), , drop = FALSE] #subsets count data here 
dim(norm_sub);length(deg_ids)
```

```{r}
#get metadata
sample_meta <- as.data.frame(colData(ds_sf)) %>%
  mutate(sample = rownames(colData(ds_sf))) %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, treatment, timepoint)

#get means and se for each gene
expr_df <- as.data.frame(norm_sub) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Protein_ID") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Protein_ID, names_to = "sample", values_to = "norm_expr") %>%
  left_join(sample_meta, by = "sample") %>% 
  group_by(Protein_ID, treatment, timepoint) %>% 
  summarize(
    mean_avg = mean(norm_expr),
    se       = sd(norm_expr) / sqrt(n()),
    sample_size = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
expr_df
```

```{r}
# pull ABS mean per gene x timepoint as the baseline 
abs_means <- expr_df %>%
  filter(treatment == "ABS") %>%
  dplyr::select(Protein_ID, timepoint, abs_mean = mean_avg)

# compute relative mean + relative SE
expr_rel_df <- expr_df %>%
  left_join(abs_means, by = c("Protein_ID", "timepoint")) %>%
  mutate(
    rel_mean = mean_avg / abs_mean,
    rel_se   = se / abs_mean
  )

# check for zero/near-zero ABS baselines -- these will produce Inf/NaN
expr_rel_df %>% filter(is.infinite(rel_mean) | is.nan(rel_mean))

expr_rel_df
```

```{r}
# add gene categories
gene_labels <- deg %>%
  dplyr::select(geneid, category, Protein_ID) %>%
  distinct(geneid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(Protein_ID = paste0(Protein_ID,"_gene"))

expr_rel_plot <- expr_rel_df %>%
  left_join(gene_labels, by = "Protein_ID") %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment, levels = c("ABS", setdiff(unique(treatment), "ABS"))))  %>% 
  mutate(gene_label  = if_else(is.na(geneid), Protein_ID, geneid))
```

Plot below for each timepoint

```{r} 
#refine the plot

## 2. Shades within each category: light -> base -> dark (skipping pure white/black)
shade_ramp <- function(base, n) {
  colorRampPalette(c("white", base, "black"))(n + 4)[3:(n + 2)]
}

expr_rel_plot <- expr_rel_plot %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment,
                             levels = c("ABS", "FASW", "multi", "Labrenzia", "Ruegeria", "Vibrio")))

gene_pal <- expr_rel_plot %>%
  distinct(category, geneid) %>%
  mutate(category = factor(category, levels = names(cat_base))) %>%
  arrange(category, geneid) %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  mutate(color = shade_ramp(cat_base[as.character(category[1])], n()),
         shape = rep(c(16, 17, 15, 18, 8, 4, 3, 0, 1, 2, 5, 6), length.out = n())) %>%
  ungroup()

gene_colors <- setNames(gene_pal$color, gene_pal$geneid)
gene_shapes <- setNames(gene_pal$shape, gene_pal$geneid)
```

```{r}
## 3. Plot
library(ggnewscale)

tp<-"1dpi"

plot_df <- expr_rel_plot %>%
  mutate(category = factor(category, levels = names(cat_base)))

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.5)
cats  <- as.character(unique(gene_pal$category))   # categories present, in keyword order

p_rel_1 <- ggplot(plot_df  %>% filter(timepoint == tp) %>% filter(!category=='NA'), #removes NA category 
                  aes(x = treatment, y = rel_mean, group = Protein_ID,
                      color = geneid, shape = geneid)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = rel_mean - rel_se, ymax = rel_mean + rel_se),
                width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.5, position = dodge) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, position = dodge) +
  scale_color_manual(values = gene_colors, breaks = gene_pal$geneid, name = "Gene") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = gene_shapes, breaks = gene_pal$geneid, name = "Gene") +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(category, levels = names(cat_base)), scales = "free_y", ncol = 4) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Expression relative to ABS (mean \u00b1 SE)",
       title = paste("DEG expression relative to ABS \u2014", tp)) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8)) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2))

p_rel_1
ggsave(file.path(path.out,'DEG_cat_expression_plots_1dpi.svg'),height = 8, width=10)
```
